format: Fixed values of the mainnet approvals program 9mE7WUJHK6dQwzK6AP6wf1eyPmePULZrGeRbXqke2ukq. Every value is hex of its raw bytes; bumps are numbers. owner = PDA ["multisig", group] under program. body = commitment(32) || group(32) || expiry(u64 LE) || rent recipient(32) || count(1) || authorities(32 each). proposal = PDA ["proposed_transaction", group, commitment, SHA-256(body)] under program. cancellation = PDA ["cancelled_transaction", proposal] under program. digest = SHA-256(domain || genesis || program || proposal || body). genesis is the mainnet genesis hash. Computed by a Python script of its own (SHA-256 and a curve check), not by the program crates. Read by sol-program/svm-tests/tests/cluster.rs.
